prompt: Many people believe that it is important to protect all wild animals, while others think that only some species should be protected. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
It is an ongoing debate that most consider that protecting fauna is crucial, while  others' opinions are that only some types of animals deserve protection. Although government bodies should preserve special animals because of limited resources, I believe that all animals in wild life have their own significant roles to maintain balance in the environment.

There is finite funding that should be allocated for endangered or important animals. For instances, one of the threatened species is the blue parrot that eats several insects , which negatively impacts plants. Moreover, bees are well-known for their ecological roles as pollinators. Most flowers depend on these species, thereby making their fruits. In addition, preserving all wildlife is unnecessary because some species are harmful to human well-being and the agricultural sector. An amount of money should be spent according to their numbers and roles in  nature.

Despite these arguments, the protection of all creatures in wildlife is significant. Because every species has its own role in the environment. If one animal disappears, it would have a negative effect on the food chain, threatening others life. For example, wolves, one of the carnivorous predators, consume with dears.  These herbivores increase rapidly when the number of wolves decreases. As a result, forests and green plants would be damaged. So, conserving predators keeps ecology in balance. In addition, an abundance of varieties of species helps the environment become healthy and stable.

To sum up, it is vital to preserve all creatures to prevent nature’s imbalance, although  there are limited resources for all wildlife.
